objective: Four steps, in this order. (1) SPLIT FIRST (DB-090 c; G3 A1): sheet_interpreter.py is 748 of 750 lines. Move the path-state group of _StreamRun (_flush_open, _open_after_close, _moveto, _lineto, _curveto, _close, _charge_points, _paint, the _op_m/_op_l/_op_c/_op_v/_op_y/_op_h/_op_re handlers and _PATH_HANDLERS, with the constants only they use) into a NEW module app/drawings/sheet_path_state.py (for example a mixin class that _StreamRun inherits), keeping every name that tests or other modules reach through sheet_interpreter importable from it (a compatibility facade). Byte-identical output: the existing goldens and the split-equivalence suite pass UNCHANGED at the split commit point. Split-facade trap (seq 130 lesson): a test that monkeypatches a name in sheet_interpreter (e.g. read_inline_dict, skip_inline_image, _SKIP_SHADING, _StreamRun._place_form) stops biting if the consumer moves - grep every monkeypatch/setattr on sheet_interpreter and prove each still reddens (patch the consuming namespace + a positive control where needed). (2) /DP DICTIONARIES (DB-090 a; G1 A): an inline image whose /DP (or /DecodeParms) value is a dictionary, or an array of dictionaries/nulls, is skipped like any other inline image: allow exactly ONE nested level for that key only, under the same byte cap; any other nested dictionary still refuses; samples are never decoded. (3) CITATIONS (DB-090 b; G1 B): sheet_inline_image.py :17 and :186 cite 8.9.5.2 for row alignment (correct: ISO 32000-1 8.9.3), :67 cites 8.9.5.2 for the allowed BitsPerComponent set (correct: 8.9.5.1 / Table 89), :84 names Table 92 for the colour-space abbreviations (correct: Table 93). (4) ITEM 2's POST-PAINT LINETO (DB-090 i): after a painting operator the current point is undefined (ISO 32000-1 8.5.2 / 8.5.3), so today an 'l' with no current point refuses the whole document. Implement ONE disclosed lenient rule that NEVER draws a segment from an undefined or stale point: an 'l' with no current point starts a new subpath AT ITS OWN end point (no segment is drawn to it; later segments draw from it), counted per page in a disclosed field whose default keeps every existing golden byte-identical. Cite the reader behaviour this matches (e.g. the Canvas 2D 'ensure there is a subpath' rule that pdf.js relies on, or MuPDF's handling) and mark it '[recalled - verify]' unless you verified it from a primary source - the G1 verifier checks it. PROHIBITED: reopening at the last pre-paint point (that invents a segment). Curves (c/v/y) with no current point STAY a typed refusal in this packet (report whether any real file hits one). Then re-run the six real files by sha256 and report honestly per item.
